remarks: Nestled on a stunning 1.3-acre park-like property in the heart of Darien, 215 Leroy is a must-see! Just a short stroll to town and Darien High School, this expansive 5-bedroom home features a beautiful in-ground heated pool, along with over 5,000 square feet of luxurious living space.   Upon entering, you'll find a formal living room, dining room, and foyer leading to the impressive great room. This central space flows seamlessly into the newly updated kitchen and dining area, complete with a stylish new wet bar. The main floor also boasts a spacious playroom, a versatile office, and an additional bedroom with an ensuite bath.   Upstairs, the bright primary bedroom includes a newly renovated ensuite bath and walk-in closet, along with three additional bedrooms. Don't forget to explore the studio above the 2-car garage-perfect for an at home gym or additional office! Enjoy Darien's pristine beaches and parks, and bustling town with incredible restaurants and shopping, all one hour from the city.
